page.overview:
Who is Daikon Devil?

The Daikon Devil's body is a massive greenish-yellow Daikon with its roots on the top of its head and light blue tips on the end of it arm alongside gray eyes.

Nothing is currently known about the The Daikon Devil's personality except it presumably possesses hatred for humans like all non-humanoid devils.

At some point, the Daikon Devil caused chaos in the streets, where it was eventually killed by Public Safety Devil Hunters.

As a Devil, the Daikon Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities.
